articles.titleCn: 基于信息的掩码：扩散大型语言模型强化学习中的结构感知扰动
articles.abstractCn: 扩散大型语言模型（dLLMs）已成为自回归模型的效率替代方案，但通过强化学习（RL）对其进行校准需要在小蒙特卡洛预算下从掩码重建子问题中估计似然替代值。现有方法通过均匀随机掩码构建这些子问题，留下了优先考虑哪些子问题的疑问。我们识别出dLLM运行过程中的系统性上游/下游结构。某些标记在揭示时会在附近未解码位置引发大幅置信度变化，我们称之为上游标记；而其他标记仅引发微小局部变化，因此属于下游标记。我们发现掩码下游标记产生的子问题比掩码上游标记产生的子问题具有显著更好的性质，我们将此现象称为子问题难度非对称性。基于这一观察，我们提出了知情掩码（IM）方法，该方法从零额外推理成本的去噪轨迹中推导出每个标记的优先级分数，并将掩码采样偏向下游标记。IM是即插即用的：将其应用于LLaDA-8B-Instruct上的三种最先进的dLLM RL方法时，它在数学和规划基准测试上实现了高达2.01%、8.68%和5.77%的相对平均增益，并提高了训练稳定性。

articles.title: Rethinking Length-Based Training: Batch Composition and Loss Normalization in Speech Token Language Models
articles.abstract: Short-to-long training is a simple curriculum for speech models, but its gains can be difficult to interpret. In speech token language models, length-based training can change the shuffle policy, batch composition, token retention, and token weights under batch-mean loss. We disentangle these factors through matched comparisons. In the tested settings, short-to-long ordering shows no independent benefit when batch composition and token exposure are fixed. First-epoch grouping lowers perplexity for Mimi under batch-mean loss, but this gain is not observed under token-balanced loss. The cross-tokenizer results are consistent with a link between chunk-length variation and token weighting. This work provides a systematic analysis protocol for studying length-based training in variable-length speech models.
articles.titleCn: 重新思考基于长度的训练：语音标记语言模型中的批次组成和损失归一化
articles.abstractCn: 短到长的训练是语音模型的简单课程，但其收益难以解释。在语音标记语言模型中，基于长度的训练可以改变洗牌策略、批次组成、标记保留和批次平均损失下的标记权重。我们通过匹配比较来分离这些因素。在测试设置中，当批次组成和标记曝光固定时，短到长的排序没有独立收益。第一轮分组降低了Mimi在批次平均损失下的困惑度，但在标记平衡损失下没有观察到这种收益。跨标记器的结果与块长度变化和标记权重之间的联系一致。这项工作为研究可变长度语音模型中基于长度的训练提供了一套系统的分析协议。

articles.title: Isolated Sign Language Recognition for Icelandic Sign Language: Experiments in a Low-resource Setting
articles.abstract: We present the first experiments on isolated sign language recognition (ISLR) for Icelandic Sign Language (ÍTM). We use ÍTM SignWiki, a dataset derived from a bilingual Icelandic--ÍTM online dictionary. It is genuinely low-resource: 1,845 videos cover 849 classes, 86% of which have only two examples, making the full task effectively one-shot recognition across signers. We compare two open-source ISLR frameworks, OpenHands and SPOTER, on three tasks of increasing vocabulary size (22, 117 and 849 classes), and evaluate three pose estimators and two forms of cross-lingual transfer. With ÍTM data alone, SPOTER outperforms OpenHands on all three tasks, and MediaPipe poses give better results than AlphaPose or SDPose. Cross-lingual transfer brings the largest gains: pretraining SPOTER on American Sign Language data before finetuning on ÍTM raises accuracy by 14--24 percentage points, to 72.7%, 47.9% and 22.6% on the three tasks, and multilingual training with data from six other sign languages lifts OpenHands from 1.41% to 28.86% on the full task. Although far from practical use, the results suggest that transfer from better-resourced sign languages is promising for very low-resource ones. We release our adapted versions of both frameworks.
articles.titleCn: 冰岛手语孤立词识别：低资源环境下的实验
articles.abstractCn: 我们展示了首个冰岛手语（ÍTM）的孤立手语识别（ISLR）实验。我们使用了ÍTM SignWiki，这是一个源自冰岛语-ÍTM双语在线词典的数据集。它是一个真正低资源的数据集：1,845个视频涵盖了849个类别，其中86%的类别只有两个样本，使得整个任务实际上变成了跨手语的单次识别。我们在词汇量逐渐增加的三个任务（22、117和849个类别）上比较了两个开源ISLR框架OpenHands和SPOTER，并评估了三种姿态估计器和两种跨语言迁移形式。仅使用ÍTM数据，SPOTER在所有三个任务上都优于OpenHands，而MediaPipe姿态比AlphaPose或SDPose效果更好。跨语言迁移带来了最大的提升：在ÍTM数据上进行微调前，使用美国手语数据预训练SPOTER可将准确率提高14-24个百分点，在三个任务上的准确率分别达到72.7%、47.9%和22.6%，而使用来自其他六种手语的数据进行多语言训练则将OpenHands在完整任务上的准确率从1.41%提升至28.86%。尽管远未达到实际应用水平，但结果表明，从资源更丰富的手语迁移到资源极低的手语具有前景。我们发布了这两个框架的改进版本。

articles.title: BELXTR: Biomedical Entity Linking via Contextualized Token Retrieval
articles.abstract: Biomedical Entity Linking disambiguates mentions to entities in a knowledge base (KB), making it the cornerstone of information extraction pipelines. While embedding-based models are a popular approach for the task, they suffer from a key limitation. They compress mentions (and entities) into a single vector, forcing the model to average away crucial fine-grained differences. We present BELXTR, a novel embedding model based on the multi-vector (a.k.a. late interaction) architecture, which allows to leverage token-level matching information. BELXTR extends the original XTR model to biomedical entity linking by integrating an existing task-specific training objective and exploring active query expansion. Experiments across ten corpora and five KBs show that BELXTR improves upon current state-of-the-art in half of the corpora with an average improvement of 5pp recall@1. The largest gains are reported on the challenging cross-species gene disambiguation subtask, where BELXTR outperforms an LLM-powered retrieve-and-rerank pipeline and closely approaches a specialized rule-based system. Our results highlight multi-vector models as a practical alternative to hard-to-maintain rule-based systems or in scenarios where LLM-based reranking is too costly as in PubMed-scale mining. The code to reproduce our experiments can be found at: https://github.com/sg-wbi/belxtr.
articles.titleCn: BELXTR：基于上下文化标记检索的生物医学实体链接
articles.abstractCn: 生物医学实体链接旨在将文本中的提及消歧为知识库中的实体，是信息抽取流程的核心。尽管基于嵌入的模型是处理该任务的常用方法，但它们存在一个关键局限：将提及（和实体）压缩成一个向量，迫使模型平均掉关键的细粒度差异。我们提出了BELXTR，这是一种基于多向量（即晚期交互）架构的新型嵌入模型，能够利用词元级别的匹配信息。BELXTR通过整合现有的任务特定训练目标和探索主动查询扩展，将原始的XTR模型扩展到生物医学实体链接领域。在涵盖十个语料库和五个知识库的实验中显示，BELXTR在半数语料库中优于当前最先进水平，平均召回率@1提升了5个百分点。最大的提升出现在具有挑战性的跨物种基因消歧子任务上，BELXTR的性能优于基于LLM的检索和重排序流程，并接近专门的基于规则的系统。我们的结果表明，多向量模型是难以维护的基于规则系统或LLM重排序成本过高的场景（如PubMed规模挖掘）的实用替代方案。可复现我们实验的代码可在：https://github.com/sg-wbi/belxtr。

articles.title: MemoryAthena: Adaptive Routing over Latent and Generated Memories
articles.abstract: Learned-memory methods store information in an explicit table and consume it through a separate reader, allowing addressing, storage, and reading to be modified independently. We study whether useful memory can also be generated rather than only retrieved. MemoryAthena uses three pathways: direct Engram retrieval (E), generation from retrieved Engram cues (GE), and generation from causal backbone states without consulting the memory table (GH). Generated memory is conditionally useful: it can complement E in one context but interfere with it in another. MemoryAthena therefore treats E as an anchor and learns when a generated representation should intervene. With the backbone, memory, generators, and readers frozen, a lightweight causal routing head is trained from counterfactual future-token likelihood advantages of GE and GH relative to E. At inference time, an admitted candidate modifies the E residual through bounded interpolation, while rejection recovers the direct pathway exactly. On question answering, MemoryAthena raises the five-task average from 37.65 to 39.28 over the direct pathway of the same checkpoint, while the six-task general-NLP average increases from 76.73 to 79.13. The complete memory-side system contains approximately 201M parameters, excluding the frozen backbone. Further analyses show complementary strengths among E, GE, and GH across tasks and inputs. These results support generated memory as a selective correction to direct retrieval and highlight routing when, which, and how strongly to intervene as the central challenge.
articles.titleCn: 记忆雅典娜：基于潜在记忆和生成记忆的自适应路由
articles.abstractCn: 学习型记忆方法将信息存储在显式表格中，并通过独立的读取器进行读取，从而允许寻址、存储和读取独立修改。我们研究是否除了检索之外，还可以生成有用的记忆。MemoryAthena 使用三种途径：直接 Engram 检索（E）、从检索到的 Engram 提示生成（GE）以及从因果主干状态生成而不参考记忆表格（GH）。生成的记忆具有条件性效用：在一种情境下它可以补充 E，但在另一种情境下会干扰 E。因此，MemoryAthena 将 E 视为锚点，并学习何时应该介入生成的表示。在主干、记忆、生成器和读取器冻结的情况下，通过训练一个轻量级的因果路由头，从 GE 和 GH 相对于 E 的反事实未来标记似然优势中学习。在推理时，被接受的候选者通过有界插值修改 E 的残差，而拒绝则精确恢复直接路径。在问答任务中，MemoryAthena 将同一检查点的直接路径的五任务平均性能从 37.65 提升至 39.28，而六任务通用 NLP 平均性能从 76.73 提升至 79.13。完整的记忆侧系统包含约 201M 参数，不包括冻结的主干。进一步分析显示 E、GE 和 GH 在任务和输入之间存在互补优势。这些结果支持生成记忆作为直接检索的选择性纠正，并强调何时、以何种方式以及以何种强度介入作为核心挑战。

articles.title: ARAFA: An LLM-Generated Arabic Fact-Checking Dataset
articles.abstract: Automatic fact-checking poses a significant challenge in Arabic natural language processing due to the scarcity of datasets and resources. In this manuscript, we introduce Arafa, a new large-scale dataset for fact-checking in Modern Standard Arabic, constructed through an automated framework leveraging large language models (LLMs). The dataset was constructed through a three-step pipeline: (1) claim generation from Arabic Wikipedia pages with supporting textual evidence, (2) claim mutation to generate challenging counterfactual claims with refuting evidence, and (3) an automatic validation step to validate that the generated claims are either supported or refuted by their accompanying evidence, or if the evidence does not provide enough information to judge the validity of the claims. The resulting dataset comprises 181,976 claim-evidence pairs labeled as supported, refuted, or not enough information. Human evaluation carried out on a test sample from the dataset demonstrated strong inter-annotator agreement (kappa = 0.89) using Cohen's Kappa for supported claims and (kappa = 0.94) for refuted claims. Automatic validation based on a human-evaluated sample achieved 86% accuracy for supported claims and 88% for refuted ones. To showcase Arafa's value as a resource for automatic Arabic fact-checking, four open-source transformer-based models were fine-tuned using Arafa, with the top-performing model achieving a Macro F1-score of 77% on the test data. In addition to Arafa being the first large-scale dataset for Arabic fact-checking, our framework presents a scalable approach for developing similar resources for other low-resource languages.
articles.titleCn: ARAFA：一个由大型语言模型生成的阿拉伯语事实核查数据集
articles.abstractCn: 自动事实核查在阿拉伯语自然语言处理中构成重大挑战，这主要源于数据集和资源的匮乏。在本论文中，我们介绍了Arafa，一个用于现代标准阿拉伯语事实核查的新的大型数据集，该数据集通过利用大型语言模型（LLMs）的自动化框架构建而成。数据集的构建遵循三步流程：（1）从阿拉伯语维基百科页面生成声明并附上支持性文本证据；（2）通过生成具有反驳证据的挑战性反事实声明来变异声明；（3）自动验证步骤，以验证生成的声明是否被其伴随的证据支持或反驳，或者如果证据不足以判断声明的有效性。最终形成的数据集包含181,976个声明-证据对，被标记为支持、反驳或信息不足。对数据集测试样本进行的人工评估显示，使用Cohen's Kappa方法，支持声明的标注者间一致性系数为0.89，反驳声明的标注者间一致性系数为0.94。基于人工评估样本的自动验证，支持声明的准确率达到86%，反驳声明的准确率达到88%。为了展示Arafa作为自动阿拉伯语事实核查资源的价值，我们使用Arafa对四个基于Transformer的开源模型进行了微调，其中表现最佳模型的测试数据Macro F1分数达到77%。除了Arafa是首个用于阿拉伯语事实核查的大型数据集外，我们的框架还为开发其他低资源语言的类似资源提供了一种可扩展的方法。

articles.title: Auditing Proxy-Based Validation Across Text Spans
articles.abstract: Evaluation scores are often validated by their agreement with inexpensive proxy labels. When the score and the proxy are computed from the same text span, however, that agreement can arise from surface evidence the two share rather than from the semantic construct the proxy is meant to represent. We make the distinction explicit by declaring the score, its span, the proxy and the target construct as a validation contract, then re-evaluating that proxy rule strictly outside the scored span. In a controlled HotpotQA correctness experiment varying only the shared text boundary, the score agrees with its proxy far better than with correctness at a 50-character prefix: the gap is +0.184, collapsing to at most +0.045 from 120 characters onward. At that short prefix the score still predicts whether the answer string appears later (AUC 0.634) while an equivalence test places its agreement with correctness at chance, so the reported proxy agreement does not establish that the score ranks correctness. On OR-Bench, suppressing each model's recurring opening templates removes most of the score's association with the refusal proxy, while matched-volume deletion removes almost none and construct agreement stays at chance. Only three of eleven external contracts support the off-span control, and none of the routing studies we sampled released the generations it needs. We therefore ask that a proxy-based validation claim declare the span each label is read from, report the construct agreement beside the proxy agreement, and release the generations that let the proxy be re-read off the scored span.

articles.titleCn: 跨文本范围审计基于代理的验证
articles.abstractCn: 评估分数通常通过与低成本代理标签的一致性来验证。然而，当分数和代理标签从相同的文本片段计算得出时，这种一致性可能源于两者共享的表面证据，而非代理标签旨在表示的语义结构。我们通过声明分数、其片段、代理标签和目标结构为一个验证契约，然后在评分片段之外严格重新评估该代理规则，从而明确这一区别。在一个仅改变共享文本边界的受控HotpotQA正确性实验中，分数与其代理标签在50字符前缀上的同意度远好于与正确性的同意度：差距为+0.184，从120字符起缩小至最多+0.045。在该短前缀上，分数仍能预测答案字符串是否随后出现（AUC 0.634），而等价性测试将其与正确性的同意度置于偶然水平，因此所报告的代理同意度并未证明分数能排序正确性。在OR-Bench上，抑制每个模型的反复出现的开头模板消除了分数与拒绝代理标签的大部分关联，而匹配体积删除几乎未消除任何关联，结构同意度仍维持在偶然水平。只有11个外部契约中的三个支持跨片段控制，而我们抽样的所有路由研究均未发布其所需的生成数据。因此，我们要求基于代理标签的验证声明需声明每个标签读取的片段，在代理同意度旁边报告结构同意度，并发布允许代理在评分片段之外重新读取的生成数据。

articles.title: Latest Exact Match Attention
articles.abstract: We introduce latest exact match attention (LEMA), an attention variant for transformers where queries and keys are binarized and each query attends only to the latest exactly matching key. We prove that LEMA transformers with chain of thought can simulate word-RAMs, as was recently shown for the less restrictive rightmost hard attention. In contrast to prior hard attention variants, the restriction to exact matches enables an efficient converse direction: word-RAMs can simulate LEMA transformers at a cost per token independent of the context length. Together, these results yield a close correspondence between the two computational models in terms of both compute and memory. Beyond the theory, we propose a training method for LEMA transformers that handles their non-differentiable operations with a straight-through estimator for the binarization and a soft attention surrogate annealed towards LEMA. On a synthetic associative recall task, LEMA models trained this way use their growing state to store and recall a large number of associations, outperforming gated DeltaNet (GDN) with its fixed state size. As a first scaling test, we train LEMA language models with up to 834 million parameters. They match softmax transformers of around half their size in loss and, on repeated rare phrases and a needle-retrieval task, remain behind softmax transformers but recall across longer distances than GDN models of comparable size. Finally, we implement dictionary-based inference for LEMA transformers and show constant generation speed comparable to GDN despite their growing state, with the dictionaries residing in main memory rather than VRAM. Code is available at https://github.com/moritzbroe/latest_exact_match_attention.
articles.titleCn: 最新精确匹配注意力
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了最新精确匹配注意力（LEMA），这是一种变体注意力机制，用于Transformer模型，其中查询和键被二值化，每个查询仅关注最新且完全匹配的键。我们证明，结合思维链的LEMA Transformer可以模拟词-RAM，正如最近对限制较少的最右硬注意力所展示的那样。与先前的硬注意力变体不同，精确匹配的限制使得能够实现高效的逆向方向：词-RAM可以在与上下文长度无关的每个token成本下模拟LEMA Transformer。这些结果共同表明，这两种计算模型在计算和内存方面都存在密切对应关系。在理论之外，我们提出了一种针对LEMA Transformer的训练方法，该方法通过二值化的直通估计器处理其不可微分的操作，并使用向LEMA退火的软注意力替代方案。在一个合成联想回忆任务中，采用这种方法训练的LEMA模型利用其不断增长的状态来存储和回忆大量联想，其性能优于具有固定状态大小的门控DeltaNet（GDN）。作为首次扩展测试，我们训练了参数高达8.34亿个的LEMA语言模型。它们在损失方面与大约一半大小的softmax Transformer相当，但在重复罕见短语和针头检索任务中，虽然仍落后于softmax Transformer，但比同等大小的GDN模型具有更长的距离回忆能力。最后，我们为LEMA Transformer实现了基于字典的推理，并展示了尽管其状态不断增长，但与GDN相比具有恒定的生成速度，且字典存储在主内存而非VRAM中。代码可在https://github.com/moritzbroe/latest_exact_match_attention获取。

articles.title: Reply to comments arXiv:2512.07881 and arXiv:2601.06104 on quantum structure in human and AI-generated language
articles.abstract: We reply to the comments by M. Sienicki and K. Sienicki (arXiv:2512.07881) and by K. Sienicki (arXiv:2601.06104) on our work on quantum-mechanical statistics in human language (arXiv:2407.14924) and on quantum structure in AI-generated language (arXiv:2511.21731). We thank the authors for their careful reading and address what we consider to be the main points of criticism: the exploratory nature of the protocol used in the experiments with large language models; the role of marginal-law violations, and of the Contextuality-by-Default criterion, in the identification of entanglement; the limited diagnostic value of a Bose-Einstein fit taken in isolation; the meaning of assigning the lowest energy levels to the most frequent words; and the relation between the vector spaces used by LLMs and quantum state spaces. We also correct a typographical error in Table 3 of arXiv:2511.21731, which does not affect the reported CHSH value.

articles.titleCn: 回复关于人类和人工智能生成语言中量子结构的arXiv:2512.07881和arXiv:2601.06104的评论
articles.abstractCn: 我们回应了M. Sienicki和K. Sienicki（arXiv:2512.07881）以及K. Sienicki（arXiv:2601.06104）对我们关于人类语言量子力学统计（arXiv:2407.14924）和人工智能生成语言量子结构（arXiv:2511.21731）的研究的评论。我们感谢作者们仔细阅读，并回应了他们认为的主要批评点：大型语言模型实验中使用的协议的探索性；边际定律违反和默认情境性在识别纠缠中的作用；单独取玻色-爱因斯坦拟合的有限诊断价值；将最低能量级分配给最频繁词语的意义；以及LLM使用的向量空间与量子态空间之间的关系。我们还更正了arXiv:2511.21731中表3的一个排版错误，该错误不影响报告的CHSH值。

articles.title: Syndrome, Synergy, and Safety: Structured Reasoning and Knowledge-Driven Alignment for TCM Prescription Generation
articles.abstract: Applying large language models to Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) prescription generation reveals three clinically critical gaps: models produce end-to-end mappings without auditable reasoning following the li-fa-fang-yao paradigm (SR Gap), treat each encounter in isolation without follow-up adjustment via sui zheng jia jian (LA Gap), and fail to enforce absolute contraindication rules such as Shi Ba Fan (SC Gap). We propose a progressive four-stage framework (SFT $\to$ PG-CoT $\to$ Dynamic $\to$ K-RL) that addresses each gap: PG-CoT constrains CoT distillation under the li-fa-fang-yao paradigm to produce auditable diagnostic chains, Dynamic SFT models patient trajectories with explicit transition reasoning, and K-RL encodes deterministic pharmacological rules as rule-based DPO preference signals. Across 12 fine-tuned models and 6 zero-shot baselines, our framework substantially improves prescription quality over zero-shot baselines---with a 7B model (Mistral-7B) surpassing zero-shot GPT-5 on all three TCM evaluation metrics.

articles.titleCn: 综合征、协同作用与安全性：基于结构化推理和知识驱动的中药处方生成
articles.abstractCn: 将大型语言模型应用于中医药（TCM）处方生成，揭示了三个临床关键差距：模型遵循君臣佐使范式生成端到端映射，但缺乏可审计的推理（SR差距）；孤立地处理每次诊疗，未通过随证加减进行后续调整（LA差距）；以及未能执行绝对禁忌规则，如十巴方（SC差距）。我们提出一个渐进式四阶段框架（SFT→PG-CoT→动态→K-RL），针对每个差距进行处理：PG-CoT在君臣佐使范式下约束CoT蒸馏，生成可审计的诊断链；动态SFT模型通过明确的转换推理对患者轨迹进行建模；K-RL将确定性药理规则编码为基于规则的DPO偏好信号。在12个微调模型和6个零样本基线模型中，我们的框架显著提升了处方质量，其中7B模型（Mistral-7B）在所有三个中医药评估指标上均超越了零样本GPT-5。

articles.title: Slow Decay and Silenced Expression: Iterated Subliminal Trait Transfer in Language-Model Lineages
articles.abstract: Language models are increasingly trained on the outputs of other models, forming chains that we call lineages, in which a trait present in one generation can pass to the next. Prior work on subliminal learning has shown that a teacher's trait can transmit to a student through filtered data carrying none of the trait's content. However, the evidence covers only a single training step. We study whether such a trait holds or fades across lineages. We instill the trait into three copies of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and iterate the training step to depth ten from each, reading every generation two ways on the same held-out prompts: a keyword screen that looks for expressions of the trait in the model's output, and an activation probe that projects each model's displacement from the base onto a direction built from the other lineages' teachers. We report two findings. First, the trait persists through ten generations across three lineages. The instilled models express it on every completion; the keyword-screen rate falls to 55.6% after the first step and to 21.1% by generation ten. The base itself matches the screen on none of its 300 completions. Second, the trait can be present internally while absent behaviorally. When the model's default system prompt is removed at evaluation, the generation-ten students' keyword-screen rate is zero on every prompt while the probe score stays positive on every prompt. Steering the untreated base with the displacement of a generation-ten student, which is trained and measured under the default system prompt, induces screened expression of the trait even with the system prompt removed, while that same student shows no expression of the trait with the system prompt removed.

articles.titleCn: 缓慢衰减与沉默表达：语言模型谱系中的迭代潜意识特质传递
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型越来越多地基于其他模型的输出进行训练，形成我们称之为谱系的链条，其中某一代中存在的特征可以传递到下一代。先前关于潜意识学习的研究表明，教师特征可以通过不包含该特征内容的过滤数据传递给学生。然而，这些证据仅涵盖单个训练步骤。我们研究了这种特征是否能在谱系中持续存在或逐渐消失。我们将特征植入Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct的三个副本中，并从每个副本迭代训练至第十层，以相同保留提示对每一代进行两种读取方式：关键词筛选，用于在模型输出中寻找特征表达；激活探针，将每个模型的位移从基准投影到由其他谱系教师构建的方向上。我们报告了两个发现。首先，该特征在三个谱系中持续存在了十代。植入模型的每一代都表达该特征；关键词筛选率在第一步后降至55.6%，到第十代降至21.1%。基准本身在其300次完成中从未匹配筛选结果。其次，该特征可以内部存在而行为上不表现出来。在评估时移除模型默认系统提示，第十代学生的关键词筛选率在所有提示上均为零，而探针分数在所有提示上保持正值。用第十代学生的位移引导未经处理的基准（该学生是在默认系统提示下训练和测量的），即使移除系统提示，也能诱导出特征的关键词筛选表达，而同一学生在移除系统提示时则不表现出特征。

articles.title: How Strongly Should Task State Influence an LLM Agent?
articles.abstract: Long-horizon assigned work requires an LLM agent to track the state of a task: which steps are done, blocked, cancelled, or open to repetition. Agent systems either keep this state as text in the prompt and rely on the model to read that text, or move the state into a module that enforces it, and each system is evaluated as a whole, so no one knows how much reliability comes from the state being shown, told, or enforced. We fix the task rules, the model, and paired episodes and vary how strongly task state reaches the agent: a raw transcript, an exact checklist, per-turn directives from a state machine compiled from the brief and advanced only by execution receipts, or an enforcement gate on that machine that refuses state-violating actions; every episode is scored by exact payload matching against dynamic ground truth. Across three models, two reasoning regimes, and two domains, four findings hold without per-turn reasoning: displaying accurate state is unreliable, an unverified ledger the agent writes itself beats an accurate checklist it is shown, directives help in proportion to the model's obedience, and enforcement needs no obedience but is bounded by the correctness of its state and by the matcher that maps requests to steps; per-turn reasoning at a 235B agent compresses these separations without repairing the text rungs. The same gate, compiled from $τ^2$-bench's airline policy, raises a 235B agent's pass$^1$ from 0.39 to 0.54 and changes nothing for a 35B agent that rarely violates the policy; on PM-Bench, where acting turns on recognizing a cue rather than on state, showing the record is the best rung--matching or beating both gates and reversing the ledger-over-checklist finding--and enforcing the matcher's judgement drops a 35B agent below its raw transcript. Enforcement pays when failures are state-decidable and frequent, and hurts when the gate's judgement is wrong.

articles.titleCn: 任务状态应如何强烈影响大型语言模型代理？
articles.abstractCn: 长期任务分配需要大型语言模型代理来追踪任务状态：哪些步骤已完成、受阻、取消或可重复执行。代理系统要么将此状态作为文本保存在提示中，依赖模型读取该文本；要么将状态移入强制执行该状态的模块。由于系统整体被评估，因此无人知晓可靠性有多少来自于状态展示、告知或强制执行。我们固定任务规则、模型和配对场景，并改变任务状态对代理的影响强度：原始文本记录、精确清单、来自从简报编译的状态机每回合指令（仅通过执行收据推进），或在该状态机上设置强制执行门，拒绝违反状态的动作；每个场景通过与动态真实情况的精确载荷匹配进行评分。跨越三种模型、两种推理机制和两个领域，四个发现无需每回合推理即可成立：展示准确状态不可靠、代理自行编写的未验证账本优于展示的精确清单、指令帮助程度与模型的服从度成正比，强制执行无需服从但受其状态正确性和请求到步骤映射匹配器的限制；在235B代理上进行每回合推理压缩了这些差异，但未修复文本环节。同一从$τ^2$-基准航空政策编译的强制执行门将235B代理的通过率从0.39提高到0.54，而对很少违反政策的35B代理则无影响；在PM-Bench上，行为基于识别提示而非状态，展示记录是最佳环节——匹配或优于强制执行门，并逆转了账本优于清单的发现——而强制执行匹配器的判断将35B代理降至原始文本记录水平。当失败可由状态决定且频繁发生时强制执行有利，当强制执行门的判断错误时则有害。

articles.title: From Utterances to Networks: Modelling Slang Adoption and Diffusion Across Subreddits
articles.abstract: Adoption and diffusion of neologisms in online communities have received renewed attention in recent years. As internet slang terms such as APT, referring to a K-pop song, and phrases such as Canon Event meaning an embarrassing but pivotal event, go viral online, it becomes increasingly important to understand the mechanisms that contribute to their success. Prior studies have often explained slang diffusion either from the perspective of social interaction or from the linguistic properties of the slang itself, but rarely from both perspectives together. One major obstacle has been the high cost of annotating slang usage in large-scale online communication. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs), however, make it possible to use them as scalable annotators for such tasks. In this study, we first curate a human-annotated benchmark to evaluate LLM performance in detecting slang usage in real Reddit communication. We then leverage LLM-based annotations to model slang adoption and diffusion. Our results show that slang diffusers with higher bridging capital are associated with increased subsequent adoption, whereas diffusers with higher bonding capital are associated with reduced adoption. We also find that wider contextual usage of a slang term is associated with a longer time before new users officially adopt it. Together, these findings suggest that both social-network structure and linguistic context shape the diffusion of neologisms in online communities.

articles.titleCn: 从言语到网络：跨不同subreddit的俚语采纳与传播建模
articles.abstractCn: 近年来，网络社区中新词的采纳与传播受到了越来越多的关注。随着像APT（指代一首K-pop歌曲）和Canon Event（指令人尴尬但关键的事件）这类网络流行语的病毒式传播，理解其成功机制变得日益重要。以往研究通常从社会互动或流行语的自身语言特征角度解释其传播，但很少同时从这两个角度出发。一个主要障碍是大规模在线交流中标注流行语使用的高成本。然而，大型语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展使其能够作为此类任务的可扩展标注工具。在本研究中，我们首先创建了一个人工标注的基准数据集，以评估LLMs在检测真实Reddit交流中流行语使用方面的性能。接着，我们利用基于LLMs的标注来建模流行语的采纳与传播。我们的结果表明，具有较高桥梁资本（bridging capital）的传播者与后续采纳率的增加相关，而具有较高联合资本（bonding capital）的传播者则与采纳率的降低相关。此外，我们发现一个流行语术语在更广泛的语境中使用与它被新用户正式采纳前的时间更长相关。综合这些发现表明，社会网络结构和语言语境共同塑造了网络社区中新词的传播。

articles.title: Efficient Cost-Aware LLM Evaluation via Bayesian Bandit Gittins Indices
articles.abstract: Exhaustively evaluating every candidate LLM configuration on every benchmark item to identify a high-performing one is costly. We formulate configuration selection as a cost-aware Bayesian bandit problem and propose GittinsEval, which draws on the Bayesian-optimal Gittins policy to determine which configuration to evaluate next and when to stop. We extend the policy with an anytime recommendation rule over both fully and partially evaluated configurations, using an LCB-style score to account for posterior uncertainty. GittinsEval is computationally efficient, requiring only lightweight online updates after offline precomputation. Across GSM8K, PIQA, AlpacaEval, and MMLU response matrices, GittinsEval is consistently competitive, with particularly strong gains over configuration-level Bayesian optimization on large-example benchmarks and over cost-unaware bandit baselines on large-candidate tasks. Crucially, GittinsEval often attains near-zero simple regret using only 1% to 2% of the exhaustive-evaluation cost; it also offers an adaptive stopping rule that typically triggers at 1% to 10%.

articles.titleCn: 基于贝叶斯 bandit Gittins 指标的成本感知大型语言模型高效评估
articles.abstractCn: 对每个基准项上的所有候选LLM配置进行详尽评估以识别高性能配置的成本高昂。我们将配置选择形式化为一个成本感知的贝叶斯多臂老虎机问题，并提出了GittinsEval，该方案借鉴贝叶斯最优Gittins策略来确定下一个要评估的配置以及何时停止。我们通过在完全和部分评估的配置上应用随时推荐规则扩展了该策略，并使用LCB风格的分数来考虑后验不确定性。GittinsEval在计算上是高效的，仅需在离线预计算后进行轻量级在线更新。在GSM8K、PIQA、AlpacaEval和MMLU响应矩阵上，GittinsEval始终具有竞争力，特别是在大型示例基准上对配置级贝叶斯优化取得了显著提升，以及在大型候选任务上对成本无感知老虎机基线取得了明显优势。关键在于，GittinsEval通常仅需1%至2%的详尽评估成本即可实现接近零的简单遗憾；它还提供了一种自适应停止规则，通常在1%至10%时触发。

articles.title: Qwen3.8-Omni: Towards Native Omni-Modal Agents
articles.abstract: We introduce Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash, a natively multimodal agentic model for real-world multimodal productivity. Compared with previous omni models, which primarily emphasized perception and interaction, Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash substantially improves multimodal understanding and reasoning, as well as performance on long-horizon agentic tasks. These capabilities are supported by a native multimodal co-training strategy that preserves strong text-domain capabilities while facilitating the transfer of agentic capabilities from text to audio and video tasks. The model inherits the sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture of Qwen3.8-Next and extends the context window to one million tokens, supporting long-context multimodal reasoning and long-horizon planning. These advances enable integration into production workflows as a primary agent or a specialized sub-agent, supporting video editing, long-form audio and video translation, music-conditioned music video or movie generation, and video-based note or omni-skill creation. To address the lack of native audio and video support in existing agent harnesses, we release Qwen-MM-Plugins, a lightweight open-source plugin framework for multimodal productivity. We further frame real-time multimodal interaction as a system-level challenge requiring orchestration of context and memory management, tool use, and sub-agent delegation. Accordingly, we release Qwen-Live-Harness, an open-source framework for building responsive, real-time multimodal agents based on Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash achieves strong performance across multimodal understanding, reasoning, long-horizon agentic execution, and video productivity tasks. These results and the accompanying open-source tools support Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash as a practical foundation for deploying natively multimodal agents in research and production.
articles.titleCn: Qwen3.8-Omni：迈向原生多模态智能体
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash，一个为现实世界多模态生产力设计的原生多模态智能体模型。与以往主要强调感知和交互的全模态模型相比，Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash显著提升了多模态理解和推理能力，以及在长时程智能体任务上的表现。这些能力得益于一种原生多模态协同训练策略，该策略在保留强大文本领域能力的同时，促进了从文本到音频和视频任务的智能体能力的迁移。该模型继承了Qwen3.8-Next的稀疏专家混合（MoE）架构，并将上下文窗口扩展到一百万个token，支持长上下文多模态推理和长时程规划。这些进步使其能够作为主要智能体或专门子智能体集成到生产工作流程中，支持视频编辑、长格式音频和视频翻译、音乐条件下的音乐视频或电影生成，以及基于视频的笔记或全技能创建。为解决现有智能体框架在原生音频和视频支持方面的不足，我们发布了Qwen-MM-Plugins，一个轻量级开源的多模态生产力插件框架。我们进一步将实时多模态交互视为一个系统级挑战，需要协调上下文和内存管理、工具使用和子智能体委托。相应地，我们发布了Qwen-Live-Harness，一个基于Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash构建响应式实时多模态智能体的开源框架。广泛的评估表明，Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash在多模态理解、推理、长时程智能体执行和视频生产力任务方面均表现出色。这些结果及配套的开源工具支持Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash作为部署原生多模态智能体的实用基础，适用于研究和生产。

articles.title: Rewired or Gated? How Instruction Tuning Shapes Knowledge-Conflict Circuits in LLMs
articles.abstract: In language models, the choice between believing the prompt and believing the weights is made by a handful of identifiable attention heads. Instruction tuning changes how models behave under conflict, but whether it rewires the underlying circuit or merely gates/reweights already present components, remains unknown. We provide the first mechanistic base-vs-instruct comparison of conflict-resolution circuits, across three families (Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen-2.5-3B, Gemma-3-4B). Five independent methods, node and edge attribution, superposition role analysis, causal ablation, and path patching, converge on gating, with the same heads, in the same late-layers, are found to be reweighted rather than replaced with a high node overlap (0.60-0.82). Behaviorally, tuning shifts models toward parametric memory, making instruct models reject a terse counterfactual context far more than base ones, the opposite of a naive user-following expectation. Yet this added skepticism is a factor of framing since it disappears when the same false claim is delivered as a coherent, evidential passage. The robustness that instruction tuning buys against terse injection is therefore real but narrow. More broadly, we believe that because the conflict circuit is preserved rather than rebuilt, interpretability and control tools calibrated on base models should transfer directly to their deployed instruct siblings.

articles.titleCn: 重置还是门控？指令微调如何塑造大型语言模型中的知识冲突电路
articles.abstractCn: 在语言模型中，相信提示还是相信权重这一选择由少数可识别的注意力头执行。指令微调改变了模型在冲突下的行为，但其是重置了底层电路还是仅仅门控/重新加权了现有组件，目前尚不清楚。我们首次对三种家族（Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen-2.5-3B、Gemma-3-4B）的冲突解决电路进行了机制性的基准与指令对比。五种独立方法——节点和边归因、叠加角色分析、因果消融和路径修补——均指向门控机制，发现在相同晚层中，相同的注意力头被重新加权而非用高节点重叠（0.60-0.82）替换。行为上，微调使模型更倾向于参数化记忆，导致指令模型比基准模型更频繁地拒绝简短的反事实上下文，这与直觉的用户跟随预期相反。然而，这种增加的怀疑因语境而异，当同一错误主张以连贯的证据性段落形式呈现时，这种现象会消失。因此，指令微调在对抗简短注入方面的鲁棒性是真实存在的，但范围有限。更广泛地说，我们认为由于冲突电路得以保留而非重建，针对基准模型校准的可解释性和控制工具应能直接应用于其部署的指令版本。

articles.title: Compressing Long Context into Answer-Aligned Memory Embeddings for LLM Inference
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference is constrained by the quadratic scaling of self-attention and the linear scaling of the KV cache, increasing latency, energy consumption, and GPU memory demand as context length scales. Existing soft-compression methods either lack query-guided memory selection at inference time, train without answer-targeted supervision, or couple compression tightly to a specific decoder architecture. We propose a Context-to-Answer-Aligned Memory Compression (CMC) framework, which compresses long input contexts into compact Context Memory Embeddings (CMEs) aligned to any frozen decoder's embedding space, reducing inference costs without modifying decoder weights. CMC introduces a two-tier KV cache that combines question-guided CME selection with a local context window, and trains the compressor with answer-targeted distillation from a frozen LLM. Experiments across nine encoder-decoder combinations and four QA benchmarks show that CMC consistently outperforms the baseline, achieving up to 7.3 EM and 4.0 F1 point gains on SQuAD, while reducing inference time and energy consumption by up to 20% and peak reserved GPU memory by up to 50% at 3,000 generation tokens. Ablation studies confirm that each architectural component and training objective contributes to the performance.
articles.titleCn: 将长上下文压缩为用于LLM推理的答案对齐内存嵌入
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）推理受到自注意力机制二次缩放和KV缓存线性缩放的制约，随着上下文长度的增加，推理延迟、能耗和GPU内存需求也随之增长。现有的软压缩方法要么缺乏推理时的查询引导内存选择，要么在训练过程中缺乏针对答案的监督，或者将压缩与特定的解码器架构紧密耦合。我们提出了一种上下文到答案对齐的内存压缩（CMC）框架，该框架将长输入上下文压缩为与任何冻结解码器嵌入空间对齐的紧凑上下文内存嵌入（CMEs），从而在不修改解码器权重的情况下降低推理成本。CMC引入了两级KV缓存，结合了问题引导的CME选择和局部上下文窗口，并使用冻结LLM的答案导向蒸馏来训练压缩器。在九种编码器-解码器组合和四种问答基准测试中，实验表明CMC始终优于基线，在SQuAD上实现了高达7.3 EM和4.0 F1点的提升，同时将推理时间和能耗降低了高达20%，在3,000个生成token时将峰值预留GPU内存降低了高达50%。消融研究证实，每个架构组件和训练目标都对性能有所贡献。

articles.title: Matryoshka attribution: Learning to attribute language model outputs to representations and weights
articles.abstract: Attributing language model outputs to their internal computations is an open problem in interpretability. Existing methods, which use causal interventions, gradients, or learnable masks, either are infeasibly expensive or struggle to identify actual causally-important internal computations. We propose framing attribution as the problem of identifying nested subsets of internal components which minimise a downstream loss. To learn this task, we introduce Matryoshka Attribution (MAttr), a mask learning method that parametrises the mask with a simple differentiable sigmoid top-$k$ operator. We supervise training over all sparsities simultaneously by randomising $k$ over training, resulting in a learned ordering of components by attribution score. MAttr achieves number 1 on the official leaderboard of the Mechanistic Interpretability Benchmark (Mueller et al., 2025); our method identifies sparse and task-transferrable circuits across varying circuit bases. As a practical application, we show that MAttr can be trained with reinforcement learning to identify weight changes responsible for downstream behaviours in LLM finetuning. We train MAttr on refusal judge scores and find that restoring $1\%$ of Llama 3.1 8B Instruct's weights to their base model state is sufficient to remove refusals while maintaining capabilities. We view MAttr as a successful formulation of interpretability into a learnable objective that we can tackle with gradient descent, and encourage future work along these lines.

articles.titleCn: 套娃归因：学习将语言模型输出归因于表征和权重
articles.abstractCn: 将语言模型输出归因于其内部计算是一个可解释性领域中的开放问题。现有的方法，如使用因果干预、梯度或可学习掩码，要么成本过高而不可行，要么难以识别真正具有因果重要性的内部计算。我们提出将归因问题定义为识别能够最小化下游损失的内嵌组件子集的问题。为了学习这项任务，我们引入了套娃归因（MAttr），这是一种通过简单的可微分的Sigmoid top-k算子对掩码进行参数化的掩码学习方法。我们通过在训练过程中随机化k值，同时对所有稀疏性进行监督训练，从而获得按归因分数排序的组件学习顺序。MAttr在机械可解释性基准（Mueller等人，2025年）的官方排行榜上排名第一；我们的方法能够在不同的电路基上识别稀疏且可迁移的任务电路。作为一个实际应用，我们展示了MAttr可以通过强化学习训练，以识别LLM微调过程中导致下游行为的权重变化。我们在拒绝判断分数上训练MAttr，发现将Llama 3.1 8B Instruct的1%权重恢复到其基础模型状态足以消除拒绝行为同时保持其能力。我们将MAttr视为将可解释性成功转化为可通过梯度下降解决的可学习目标，并鼓励未来在此方向上的研究。
